description: Search customer contacts from the signed-in owner’s latest completed SHVL Xero sync by name. Returns SHVL customer IDs, names, invoice counts, open and overdue balances in minor currency units, and whether a contact email is present. Does not return email addresses, postal addresses or Xero IDs.

limit.description: Number of matching records to return; omit to use the server default.

query.description: Optional text matched against customer name in the selected business; omit to list synced records.

workspace_id.description: Selected business ID from list_shvl_workspaces. Ask the user to choose if several businesses are available; never infer another business.

name: search_xero_contacts

outputSchema.description: contacts contains SHVL customer_id values, names, has_contact_email, invoice counts and open/overdue balances in currency minor units. contact_count counts returned contacts; query echoes the search. source records the completed sync. The email-presence flag does not disclose an address.

title: Search synced Xero contacts
